question: ‘A shot at History’ is an autobiography of whom among the following Olympic medal awardees?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abhinav Bindra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Abhinav Bindra is an Indian sport shooter from Uttarakhand and is the first Indian to win the Olympic Gold medal in Beijing Olympics in 2008.
 
• He won seven medals at the Commonwealth Games (4 Gold and 2 Silver) and three at the Asian Games (1 silver).
 
• In 2018, he became the first Indian to elect as the chairman of the International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) Athletes Committee.
 
• In 2011, Abhinav Bindra published an autobiography titled A Shot at History. Hence option 4 is correct.
 
• Hunting the Hard Way was a book written by Howard Hill, a bowman from the US who was regarded as the world's greatest bowman.
 
• Firing Point is a techno-thriller novel written by Mike Maden, an American novelist who writes mostly Spy Fiction and Crime fiction genres.
